sim06_learned_head_vs_kernel_heldout_202.description: Gradient-trained MLP drive-outcome head minus SIM-10 kernel (train-refit bandwidths) held-out multiclass log loss, 94 classes, trained 2018-23, scored 2024-25 drives; positive favours learned head
sim06_learned_head_vs_kernel_heldout_202.notes: game-cluster bootstrap 4000; 8-season LOSO season-block bootstrap mean 0.0560 [0.0495,0.0627]; vs locked-bandwidth kernel 0.0671 [0.0540,0.0813]
sim06_learned_head_vs_kernel_heldout_202.plain_summary: On unseen 2024-25 drives the learned head assigns the real drive outcome higher probability than the kernel resampler; drive-level only, no engine swap.
